scenes.line1: Will your UI break in Safari?
scenes.say: Ever shipped a feature that looked perfect in Chrome, but broke in Safari? How can you catch these issues before users do?

scenes.label: Visual
scenes.sub: Visual testing spots layout bugs by comparing screenshots.
scenes.say: Visual testing compares screenshots of your app to a baseline. It quickly catches layout bugs and style regressions.
Cross-browser testing means running your tests in Chrome, Firefox, and Safari. This helps you catch browser-specific issues before your users do.
With Playwright, you can set up projects for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. This runs your tests across all three browsers, so you spot differences fast.

scenes.question: Is visual testing just for looks?
scenes.right: No, it catches layout and style bugs that break the user experience.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: thinking visual testing is just about colors. In reality, it catches layout and style bugs that can ruin the user experience.
